Download installer ↓Installation guide

The current executable is unsigned. Windows may display an unknown-publisher prompt.

What setup does

  • Finds TUNG in your Steam libraries, or lets you choose its folder.
  • Installs the runtime, launcher, native menu, and Time Warp.
  • Optionally sets Steam launch options, preserving existing game arguments.
  • Adds Wood to Windows Installed Apps with an uninstaller.
  • Keeps a file journal and backups for uninstall and recovery.

Compatibility

Windows x64 and the current Steam installation of TUNG. This initial release uses a pinned experimental UE4SS build. Game updates can require a Wood runtime update.

Time Warp controls world time dilation. Frame stepping, input recording, and replay are not included.
